ideas.pitch: A lightweight CFR (Counterfactual Regret Minimization) solver optimized for Python 3.11 and NumPy to compute approximate Nash equilibrium strategies within tight memory constraints.
ideas.title: CounterfactualRegretMinimizationEngine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the core algorithmic challenge of poker AI under strict 1 vCPU and 1 GB RAM limits by pre-computing or abstracting decision trees efficiently.

ideas.pitch: An ultra-optimized hand evaluation and equity calculation module leveraging vectorized NumPy operations to score poker hands instantly without exceeding the time bank.
ideas.title: FastHandHistoryEvaluator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the strict cumulative time bank constraint (~60 seconds for 400 hands) where slower bots will time out and forfeit.

ideas.pitch: A hybrid poker bot combining rule-based pot-odds calculation with dynamic bluff frequency adjustment based on opponent stack-to-pot ratios and historical action profiling.
ideas.title: HeuristicStateBluffer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Outperforms rigid static strategies during the Swiss Qualifier and Round-Robin stages by adapting to opponents' betting patterns within the 1 GB RAM limit.

ideas.pitch: A local multi-process testing framework that simulates the tournament runner, duplicate deals, and stdin/stdout communication to benchmark bot performance and detect memory leaks.
ideas.title: StdioProtocolTestHarness
ideas.why_it_could_win: Ensures zero crashes or protocol violations during the automated tournament, preventing accidental forfeiture caused by communication errors.

ideas.pitch: A decision-tree pruning utility that reduces betting action complexity in custom Texas Hold'em variants to fit within strict memory and compute budgets.
ideas.title: ActionAbstractionOptimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Crucial for handling custom poker variants where full game trees are too large for the 1 GB RAM and 1 vCPU constraints.
